seo.title: {name} | Wood-fire kitchen and wine bar
seo.description: Seasonal plates cooked over oak and embers, natural wine and a long table for friends. Book a table tonight.

hero.title: Cooked over fire, served with care.
hero.text: Seasonal plates from oak and embers, natural wine and a room that glows.

chapters.title: One oven, one rule.
chapters.text: Everything that leaves our kitchen has met the fire. We light the oven at noon with English oak, and it sets the pace for the whole day.

chapters.title: Close to the farm.
chapters.text: Our vegetables come from two farms in Kent, our fish from day boats in Cornwall. The menu changes when they do, sometimes twice a week.

chapters.title: A room to stay in.
chapters.text: Candles, brick and a long communal table. Come for one plate at the bar or stay for the whole night.
